pages.title: Scripture Account
pages.text: The Meridian-Restoring Pill is an emergency medicine that remains dormant within the body after consumption. When the cultivator's health falls below a critical threshold, its medicinal power activates automatically and gradually restores vitality.

pages.title: Effect
pages.text: When HP falls below 20% of maximum, restores 20% maximum HP over 45 seconds. Triggers once per dose.
